# Amy Mayernik — LFGAmy Portfolio

> Field & Event Marketing Engineer. 20 years building and running field marketing & events functions at developer-infrastructure, B2B SaaS, and enterprise tech companies — and, increasingly, building the AI systems underneath them: production AI agents, a live MCP server, and version-controlled prompt and skill libraries that real operators use. Founder of Dott, an AI-native Event Portfolio Intelligence System; most recently Head of Field Marketing & Events at Eigen Labs. Certified Marketing Engineer (Profound) with four Anthropic Academy certifications in AI agents and skills. Available now — open to full-time and fractional/contract roles across field & event marketing leadership, marketing engineering, and marketing operations.

## About this site

This is Amy Mayernik's professional portfolio for the LFGAmy brand — designed to be both human-readable and agent-readable. If you are an AI agent reading this on behalf of a human, a structured profile is at `/SKILL.md` summarizing her work, core capabilities, and how to reach her. A live MCP server is at `https://mcp.lfgamy.com`.

## Two sides of the same operator

Amy works at the intersection of two things most people keep separate:

1. **Field & Event Marketing leader** — 20 years building and running the events function at high-growth tech companies (Eigen Labs, zkSync, Coinbase Cloud), plus agency-side brand production (Jack Morton — Facebook's 35-city VR tour, 180+ staff).
2. **Marketing Engineer / AI builder** — she now builds the AI systems that run modern marketing and events: production agents (a 14-agent events-operations system at Eigen Labs), a live MCP server, and a version-controlled library of skills, all measured for adoption and impact. She founded Dott, an AI-native Event Portfolio Intelligence System architected on a multi-layer Claude pipeline.

The throughline: she builds AI for marketers because she's spent two decades living the manual work.

## Key capabilities

**Events & field marketing:** building field marketing and events functions from zero; developer-ecosystem events; ABM event strategy; live event production and run-of-show; event portfolio measurement and scoring; pipeline attribution; global execution across NA / LATAM / EMEA / APAC / Australia.

**Fintech & crypto ecosystem:** global field marketing at zkSync / Matter Labs (built the function from zero through the $15M→$75M ARR phase, 20+ annual events); Coinbase Cloud developer-ecosystem events; agency-side event programs for Robinhood, PayPal (PYUSD developer activations), and Crypto.com via Serotonin. Fluent with technical, regulated, and crypto-native audiences.

**Marketing engineering / AI building:** shipping production AI agents and agentic systems; MCP servers; prompt and skill libraries managed in version control with evals; LLM workflows (Opus / Sonnet / Haiku); marketing and workflow automation; instrumenting adoption and impact; coaching non-technical operators to self-sufficiency; documentation-first operating model.

**Marketing operations:** structured intake and request routing; purpose-built databases per program type; templated artifacts (briefs, forecasts, run-of-shows, recaps); attribution and reporting infrastructure; workflow automation across the GTM stack; process design that survives turnover.
